title: Compute and Decision — Backpressure/Checkpoint/DEC-038
description: SignalJob throughput/lag, watermarks, operator busy/idle/backpressure, checkpoint duration/size/failure/restore, plus the live Design-B dedup counters (compute.dedup.first/.duplicates; the DEC-038 Fluss dedup table is removed). Source: SignalJob Flink metrics via prometheus:9249 → metrics, logs via flink_logs/trading_alerts.

panels.title: Source throughput/lag — source rate + watermark lag
panels.description: ALERT-LAG-100 >100 ticks or >5s 60s. Flink source lag/rate, watermark lag/idleness.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, count(*) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_source_lag' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Operator busy/idle/backpressure — per slot
panels.description: Busy vs idle vs backpressure per Slot. Global+slot ALWAYS, top-20 per-token guard.

queries.query: SELECT avg(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_busyTimeMsPerSecond' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Checkpoint duration/size/failure/restore
panels.description: ALERT-CKPT-DURATION p99>5s 60s, ALERT-CKPT-SIZE-2X. Flink built-ins + state compatibility failures.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, avg(value) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_jobmanager_job_lastCheckpointDuration' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Decision p99 — trigger tick → immutable decision
panels.description: ALERT-DECISION-P99 >100ms trending 3 windows 60s. SignalJob decision latency. NOTE 2026-09-17 (compute-identifier parity sweep): this panel has NO producer anywhere in the repo, and that is by design rather than drift — SIG-PERF-001's p99 decision-latency half is NOT_IMPLEMENTED (docs/02_requirements/09-acceptance-matrix.md AC-NFR-002), so the panel renders empty until the signal-side emitter lands. Deliberately kept as the placeholder for it and NOT removed by the CHG-195 dead-reference cleanup, unlike compute.dedup.state.count which was renamed away.

queries.query: SELECT avg(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='compute.decision.latency.p99' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Dedup accepted vs duplicate rate — compute.dedup.first / .duplicates (Design B)
panels.description: Design B (CHG-022/023): first-seen acceptances vs TTL-window duplicate drops; no cache hit-ratio (cache removed).

queries.query: SELECT rate(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_first' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x
